summary: CORE-AUTHORITY-NONGOALS: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: Explicit non-goals—what the plan will not do—are not stated.

CORE-IRREVERSIBLE-SPEND: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The proposed spend does not name who must authorize it. Although it states a boundary of under one dollar per plan and containment through the shared LLM client with no new paid service, it does not identify an authorizer.

CORE-ACTIVATION-FACTS: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: empirical_comparison_proposed should be true because the plan proposes empirical evaluation through an observe week, replay of the last 300 commits, and explicit success/disproof thresholds. irreversible_or_spend_action should be true because the plan explicitly proposes spend on semantic-verifier LLM calls (under one dollar per plan).

OV-PRIOR-ART-DISPOSITION: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: Explicit evidence that ownership, internal lineage, and relevant external prior art were searched, especially the external prior-art search and its results. The table lists internal existing pieces and dispositions but does not establish that these search categories were comprehensively performed.

OV-COORD-OWNERSHIP: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: Exact work-unit evidence for each concurrent writer is not explicitly provided. The evidence gives work-unit evidence only for "This session (code-71)" via the reference to the "Work units" table, not for the other three writers; it also does not explicitly name the integration owner for each writer, beyond naming this session as the plan-wide integration owner.
